component.name: VECTOR
component.summary: Viewport Engine for Concurrent Topology & Obstacle-avoiding Routing

description.p: VECTOR is a professional schematic and technical diagram drawing engine featuring real-time orthogonal obstacle-avoiding routing, hierarchical sub-diagrams, angle snapping, interactive canvas manipulators, multi-point arrows, and rich shape stencils.

ul.li: Autonomous orthogonal Manhattan routing with dynamic bridge crossings
Hierarchical multi-level schematics with drill-down and symbol generation
Comprehensive shape stencil library with Boolean geometry operations
Customizable themes with high-contrast, dark, and light modes
Bidirectional Draw.io XML and YAML serialization
